risks.risk: Rated wattage or power output is unknown
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the panel's specification label or a screenshot of the model listing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the lowest output panel of that physical size.

risks.risk: Age or years of use is unknown
risks.proof: Photo of the purchase receipt or manufacturing date sticker.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as heavily used or near end of life.

risks.risk: Working condition or test results are unknown
risks.proof: Video clip of the panel connected to a multimeter or load showing output in sunlight.

risks.risk: Cracks, hot spots, or delamination may be present
risks.proof: Close-up clip of the glass surface under bright light, or an electroluminescence image.

risks.risk: Cables, connectors, or mounting brackets may be missing
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories next to the panel.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as panel only, with no accessories.

risks.risk: Warranty documents or original purchase receipt may be absent
risks.proof: Photo or screenshot of the warranty card or receipt.

proof_requests: Close-up of the specification label on the back of the panel
Video of the panel producing power under sunlight
Photo of any included cables, connectors, or brackets
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a solar panel, so a worst-case price is possible even without brand, model, or condition proof; unverified claims and hidden risks are priced down until evidence is provided.
